name: Bing Wallpapers
description: A screensaver slideshow of recent Bing photos.
author: hmmbob

settings.title: Number of photos
settings.description: Choose 1–8 recent Bing photos. Photos no longer in the latest selection are removed. Bing may provide fewer.

settings.title: Bing region
settings.description: The region affects the photos and caption language. Different regions may show the same photos. Captions may be in English.

settings.title: Check for new photos every
settings.description: How often to check Bing for new photos. Between checks, saved photos keep rotating according to Time per photo and remain available offline.

settings.title: Time per photo
settings.description: How long each photo stays on screen. Choose 5–3600 seconds, in steps of 5. For example, 300 seconds is 5 minutes.

settings.title: Fit to screen
settings.description: “Fill screen” may crop the edges. “Show whole photo” may leave black bars.

settings.title: Show caption and photo credit
settings.description: Show Bing's description and photo credit as text over the bottom of the photo.

settings.title: Downloaded photo width
settings.description: Choose 1920 pixels for larger screens. A smaller photo width uses less data.
